race.comment: FRAGILE LOVE (10) came from near the tail to score impressively last start over this course and distance against midweek opposition. Tackles a better field today but plummets in the weights which brings her right into contention again. BOSSED UP (3) closed in good style to just miss the placings last time out over this track and trip. This looks no harder and from a better gate he can play a key role in the outcome. SER JOH (6) resumed in the same race as BOSSED UP here a fortnight ago and did a great job to be beaten just half a length after coming from midfield on the corner. Tricky task from a poor gate but if he at least holds that first-up form this is well within reach. MISTER BIANCO (4) did his best work late to get up for fourth when resuming in the Kirby Quality over 1000m at Grafton recently. Form when second-up and at this trip is better so today's assignment sets up perfectly. FACUNDO (5) won well when resuming at Doomben and has scored at two of three second-up runs.
